messages:
carmen (Recruiter): Quick ask - candidate Igor V (Senior Infra Eng) in Spain. Team wants to hire him into our Canada entity and sponsor relocation later. Proposed comp: CAD 190,000 (~USD 140k) + CAD 10k sign-on. That pushes above our IC3-CA band top (CAD 170k). Candidate has a competing offer and deadline 2026-06-07. Can we route an exception and fast-track review? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mike (People Ops): Two things: 1) cross-entity pay differences mean we canoffer Canada payroll directly if candidate agrees. 2) above-band approvals need comp-chair signoff; I'll open CE ticket and ask comp committee for expedited review. cc @olivia

sachin (Hiring Manager): Hiring note: role is critical for MLOps rollout and we urgently need overlap with PST hours. Igor can start remote in Spain but prefers Canada relocation within 4-6 months. Team requests Canada-band compensation now to make offer competitive.

pat (Finance): Finance constraints: approving CAD190k on Canadian payroll is fine if budgeted, but switching payroll from Spain to Canada later has tax/residency implications. Also, sign-on payment in CAD vs USD needs FX handling. Need headcount delta and run-rate before approval. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

lisa (Legal): Visa note: Canada work permits vary; relocation in 4-6 months is plausible but not guaranteed. Recommend conditional relocation language and clear payroll trigger. Also confirm social security contributions across Spain->Canada transition.

hr-bot: Automated: Comp exception ticket CE-2026-115 created. Attach: offer draft, manager justification, budget worksheet, candidate deadline. SLA: 48 business hours for standard, request expedited review if noted.

carmen (Recruiter): Uploaded offer (drive.redwood/offers/igor_v_draft.pdf). Proposed wording includes conditional clause: "base salary CAD190,000 on hire through Redwood Canada; if candidate relocates to Canada payroll within 6 months, base remains unchanged; if relocation cannot be completed, payroll/location review may adjust awards per local compliance." Also asked for immediate benefits eligibility date aligned to first payroll.

mike (People Ops): Please include this short justification in the CE ticket so comp reviews quickly:

```
Candidate: Igor V
Role: Senior Infra Eng (IC3)
Proposed: CAD190k base, CAD10k sign-on
Current band: IC3-CA band top CAD170k
Justification: critical hire for MLOps launch, scarce candidate in market, candidate willing to relocate to Canada within 4-6 months; competing offers pending
Start window: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-15 (pref 6/1)
Deadline: 2026-06-07 (counteroffer)
```

pat (Finance): If comp-chair approves, Finance will need a note whether CAD190k is charged to Canada org code now or backfilled from US/EEA pool during relocation transition. Also request sign-off on FX reserve for sign-on.

olivia (Comp Chair): Reviewing CE-2026-115 now. Given deadline, I can convene comp subgroup for expedited decision. My initial leaning: approve sign-on + partial above-band uplift (CAD180k) as compromise, with guaranteed review for full CAD190k if relocation executed within 6 months. This reduces ongoing run-rate risk. Will confirm in 6-8 hours.

sachin (Hiring Manager): :thumbsup: to Olivia's compromise if it closes Igor. Need final answer before 2026-06-07. Can comp subgroup send a commitment letter template we can share with candidate?

lisa (Legal): I'll draft conditional uplift language and relocation addendum for the candidate letter. Standard clause: "upon successful relocation and payroll transfer to Redwood Canada within 180 days, candidate will receive a one-time retention adjustment or base salary increase as agreed." No retroactive pay prior to payroll transfer.

mike (People Ops): Summarizing action items: 1) comp subgroup to vote CE-2026-115 (expedite), 2) Finance to confirm org charge/FX, 3) Legal draft conditional clause, 4) Recruiter to provide offer window and send candidate provisional letter with conditional language.

carmen (Recruiter): Will send provisional offer with Olivia's provisional terms (CAD180k + CAD10k sign-on + conditional CAD10k uplift upon relocation) and ask for verbal hold until decision. Will update CE ticket with acceptance window.

olivia (Comp Chair): CE-2026-115: provisional approval for CAD180k + CAD10k sign-on; full CAD190k contingent on confirmed payroll transfer within 180 days. Formal vote to follow; subgroup will post final by EOD.

hr-bot: Automated: CE-2026-115 status updated: PROVISIONAL_APPROVED. Please attach signed provisional offer or candidate response when available.
